arguments.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
non_zero = select(details, "stars > 0")
with_ratio = compute(non_zero, ratio="forks / stars")
high = select(with_ratio, "ratio > 0.15")
low = select(with_ratio, "ratio <= 0.15")
contrib_scores = map(high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
commit_scores = map(low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
good_contrib = select(contrib_scores, "score >= 100")
good_commits = select(commit_scores, "score >= 100")
all_scores = concat(good_contrib, good_commits)
ranked = sort(all_scores, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top
